rationale: A strict improvement is interpretable only after the frozen published construction is reproduced and the exact difference contract is independently checked.
expected_information_gain: Establishes a trustworthy scope-112 baseline and tests whether the local validators agree on all 105 positive differences.
method: Run research_tools/verify_dts.py and research_tools/verify_dts_independent.py against the source-transcribed witness.
metric: DTS scope and global positive-difference uniqueness
metric_relation_to_true_objective: This is the exact frozen DTS validity contract; scope 112 is the baseline and scope <=111 is the target.
kill_condition: Stop if either independent validator rejects the source witness or reports a non-112 scope.
